resolution: The previous all-result guard is replaced with OrderRequired, which checks CandidateOrder only on accepted and unknown-applied-success results. Existing receipt replay, changed-wire collision and authorization denial are represented without candidate validation.

Universal guarded admitted replay/collision/authorization-denial propositions and concrete replay/collision witnesses use an unordered candidate while decoder, parser and checked-frame adapters are unavailable. Successful and unknown-applied-success block artifacts retain their field-order obligations.

Grouping by signature order preserves each owner subsequence and gives a deterministic order consistent with nested Alloy field declarations. A node registry permutation remains an adapter/round-trip test requirement rather than an asserted Lean theorem.
verification: Exact spec, Lean and registry hashes checked; one preliminary isolated clean workspace built and all 14 exact #check types extracted. Six final approvals and two registered clean builds remain required before guard implementation. 112 inherited + 125 document + 14 amendment gives 251 registered propositions.
scope_limit: Gameplan approval only; no runtime, parser or Java/TypeScript refinement, accessibility, G2/G3 or commercial clearance.
